name: finetune-kalel-nightly
description: Parallel small-model (<=4B) QLoRA cycle on Kal-el (iBuyPower RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB). Same promotion gates as the Spark nightly; outputs under output/kalel/. Set BASE_MODEL in ~/.config/gs/worker.env to a local <=4B instruct dir (llama-3.2-3b-instruct, qwen3-4b, or gemma-3-4b-it).
